customer_id.meaning: primary id of the customer profile record (content hash)

full_name.meaning: the customer's full legal name exactly as it appears on the government identification presented when the profile was opened

phone_number.meaning: the mobile number on file for the profile; the number the contact centre calls back on

email.meaning: the email address on file for the profile, stored exactly as the customer gave it

postal_code.meaning: the postal code of the billing address held on the profile

date_of_birth.meaning: the customer's date of birth as recorded from their identification; the basis for every minimum-age condition

member_since.meaning: the date this customer profile was first opened at any location; the basis for every tenure measured from the profile

identification_last_four.meaning: the last four digits of the government identification recorded on the profile

home_store_code.format: two letters, a hyphen and three digits, e.g. BR-118
home_store_code.meaning: the code of the store the customer treats as their home location; where in-person handling defaults to

mailing_address.meaning: the single-line mailing address on file, stored exactly as the customer gave it

preferred_contact_method.meaning: the channel the customer asked to be contacted on for service updates

marketing_opt_in.meaning: whether the customer consented to marketing contact; has no bearing on service notices

financing_plan_id.meaning: primary id of the promotional financing plan record

customer_id.meaning: the customer who holds this plan (foreign key -> customers)

variant_name.meaning: the promotional term held, written as the official full plan name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the plan, on the basis defined by the category's lifecycle states

sales_receipt_number.format: BR- followed by a four-digit year, a hyphen and six digits, e.g. BR-2025-118406
sales_receipt_number.meaning: the sales receipt this plan finances; the narrowest business key tying the plan to one till transaction

originating_store_code.format: two letters, a hyphen and three digits, e.g. BR-118
originating_store_code.meaning: the store that wrote the sale this plan finances

opened_date.meaning: the date the financing application was taken

approved_date.meaning: the date the credit decision was recorded as approved; empty while the application is still pending

activated_date.meaning: the date the plan began billing, which is the date the first statement closed; empty until then

promo_end_date.meaning: the last day of the promotional term carried by this plan; the boundary every promotional condition is measured against

closed_date.meaning: the date the plan reached a terminal state; empty while the plan is still open

original_principal.meaning: the financed amount at opening, net of any down payment; always positive

down_payment_amount.meaning: the amount the customer paid at the till on the day of sale; always positive or zero

current_balance.meaning: amount still owed on this plan; identically the running sum of every plan balance movement posted to it, positive when the customer owes

accrued_promo_interest.meaning: interest accrued but held back under the promotional term; identically the running sum of every deferred interest movement, positive while it is still held back

scheduled_monthly_payment.meaning: the payment the plan bills each cycle under its current schedule; recalculated whenever the schedule changes

statement_day.format: whole number, day of month from 1 to 28
statement_day.meaning: the day of the month on which this plan's statement closes

autopay_enrolled.meaning: whether scheduled automatic payment is in force on this plan right now

applicant_credit_score.meaning: the credit score returned by the bureau at the time the application was decided; never refreshed afterwards

joint_applicant_name.meaning: the full legal name of the joint applicant on this plan, exactly as given; empty when the plan is held alone

hardship_plan_code.meaning: which hardship arrangement is currently in force on this plan; none means the ordinary schedule applies

last_payment_date.meaning: the posting date of the most recent settled payment on this plan; empty when nothing has been paid yet

days_past_due.meaning: how many calendar days the oldest unpaid scheduled payment is overdue as of the last statement; zero when the plan is current

ledger_entry_id.meaning: primary id of the ledger entry

financing_plan_id.meaning: the plan this entry was booked to (foreign key -> financing_plans)

customer_id.meaning: the customer the plan belongs to (foreign key -> customers)

event_type.meaning: which declared ledger family this entry belongs to, written verbatim as the event type

posted_date.meaning: the date the entry was booked to the plan

billing_cycle.format: YYYY-MM, the year and month of the statement the entry falls in
billing_cycle.meaning: the billing cycle this entry belongs to; the basis for every per-cycle count and cap

amount.meaning: the signed size of the movement: amounts the customer owes more of are positive, amounts that reduce what is owed are negative

payment_channel.meaning: the channel the money arrived through; not_applicable on entries that are not payments

payment_outcome.meaning: how the payment finally cleared; not_applicable on entries that are not payments

payment_due_date.meaning: the payment due date printed on the statement for the entry's billing cycle; empty on entries no due date applies to

days_past_due.meaning: calendar days between the due date of the cycle and the posting date of this entry; zero when nothing was overdue

fee_code.meaning: which priced charge this entry is; not_applicable on entries that are not charges

waiver_reason_code.meaning: why a charge was given back; not_applicable on entries that give nothing back

sales_receipt_number.format: BR- followed by a four-digit year, a hyphen and six digits, e.g. BR-2025-118406
sales_receipt_number.meaning: the till transaction this entry traces to; the business key that ties a purchase or a return credit to one sale

item_sku.format: four letters, a hyphen and five digits, e.g. RING-40218
item_sku.meaning: the merchandise line this entry concerns; empty on entries that concern the whole plan rather than one item

source_entry_id.meaning: the earlier ledger entry this entry gives back, credits or corrects; empty on entries that stand on their own

statement_number.format: ST- followed by six digits, e.g. ST-441907
statement_number.meaning: the statement this entry was presented on; empty on entries booked between statements

allocation_bucket.meaning: which part of what is owed this entry moved; mixed when one payment was spread across several parts

financing_request_id.meaning: primary id of the financing service request record

customer_id.meaning: the customer who raised the request (foreign key -> customers)

financing_plan_id.meaning: the plan the request concerns (foreign key -> financing_plans)

request_type.meaning: what the customer asked the finance desk to arrange

request_status.meaning: where the request stands; recorded means taken but not yet confirmed by the customer

requested_amount.meaning: the amount the request concerns, such as the reduced payment asked for; zero when the request carries no amount

effective_date.meaning: the date the arrangement is asked to take effect from

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
created_at.meaning: the moment the request was taken

protection_plan_id.meaning: primary id of the protection plan record

customer_id.meaning: the customer who holds this plan (foreign key -> customers)

variant_name.meaning: the coverage held, written as the official full plan name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the coverage, on the basis defined by the category's lifecycle states

covered_item_sku.format: four letters, a hyphen and five digits, e.g. RING-40218
covered_item_sku.meaning: the single merchandise item this plan covers; one plan never covers two items

covered_item_description.meaning: the description of the covered piece as it was written on the sales receipt

sales_receipt_number.format: BR- followed by a four-digit year, a hyphen and six digits, e.g. BR-2025-118406
sales_receipt_number.meaning: the till transaction the covered item was sold on; the key that ties coverage to a purchase

item_value_at_purchase.meaning: the price the covered item was sold at, before tax; the basis for every value-based coverage limit

purchased_date.meaning: the date the plan was bought; empty while the plan is only quoted

effective_date.meaning: the date coverage begins, which is the day the waiting period ends

expiry_date.meaning: the last day coverage runs to; empty on coverage that does not expire

closed_date.meaning: the date the plan reached a terminal state; empty while it is still live

premium_amount.meaning: the price of the plan as sold; zero on coverage that is included with the item

premium_paid_to_date.meaning: what the customer has paid toward this plan so far; identically the running sum of every premium movement

remaining_benefit_allowance.meaning: how much benefit is still available to settle claims on this plan; identically the running sum of every allowance movement

deductible_amount.meaning: what the customer pays out of pocket per accepted claim under this plan

last_inspection_date.meaning: the date of the most recent inspection logged against the covered item; empty when none has been logged

next_inspection_due_date.meaning: the date by which the next inspection must be logged for coverage to stay in force

inspection_store_code.format: two letters, a hyphen and three digits, e.g. BR-118
inspection_store_code.meaning: the store that logged the most recent inspection

claims_settled_count.meaning: how many claims have been settled on this plan over its whole life

transferred_to_name.meaning: the full name of the person the plan was transferred to, exactly as given; empty unless the plan was transferred

premium_schedule.meaning: how the premium on this plan is collected

protection_entry_id.meaning: primary id of the protection ledger entry

protection_plan_id.meaning: the plan this entry was booked to (foreign key -> protection_plans)

customer_id.meaning: the customer the plan belongs to (foreign key -> customers)

event_type.meaning: which declared ledger family this entry belongs to, written verbatim as the event type

posted_date.meaning: the date the entry was booked against the plan

amount.meaning: the signed size of the movement: grants and premiums received are positive, refunds and benefit consumed are negative

claim_reference.format: CL- followed by six digits, e.g. CL-330871
claim_reference.meaning: the claim this entry belongs to; the narrowest key tying a filing, a settlement or a denial to one loss; empty on entries that are not claim entries

claim_type.meaning: what the customer claimed for; not_applicable on entries that are not claim entries

claim_outcome.meaning: how the claim was finally answered; not_applicable while the claim is still open

denial_reason_code.meaning: the single recorded ground for refusing a claim; not_applicable on entries that refuse nothing

inspection_result.meaning: what the inspection found; not_applicable on entries that are not inspections

inspection_store_code.format: two letters, a hyphen and three digits, e.g. BR-118
inspection_store_code.meaning: the store that carried out the inspection; empty on entries that are not inspections

deductible_charged.meaning: what the customer paid out of pocket toward this settlement; zero where no deductible applied

covered_item_sku.format: four letters, a hyphen and five digits, e.g. RING-40218
covered_item_sku.meaning: the covered piece this entry concerns

service_order_reference.format: WO- followed by six digits, e.g. WO-772140
service_order_reference.meaning: the bench work order a claim was sent to the workshop under; empty where no bench work was raised

payment_channel.meaning: the channel a premium or refund moved on; not_applicable on entries that move no money to or from the customer

billing_period.format: YYYY-MM, the year and month the entry is accounted to
billing_period.meaning: the accounting period this entry belongs to; the basis for every per-period count

source_entry_id.meaning: the earlier protection ledger entry this entry answers, refunds or corrects; empty on entries that stand on their own

claim_reference.meaning: the claim the request concerns; empty on requests that are not about a claim

effective_date.meaning: the date the customer asked the arrangement to take effect from

declared_value.meaning: the value the piece was taken in at for the chain's care, custody and control cover

protection_claim_reference.format: CL- followed by six digits, e.g. CL-330871
protection_claim_reference.meaning: the protection claim that answered for this entry; empty where the customer paid for it themselves

discount_reason_code.meaning: why an amount was taken off; not_applicable on entries that take nothing off

quality_check_result.meaning: what the final check found; not_applicable on entries that are not checks

technician_code.format: BEN- followed by three digits, e.g. BEN-207

source_entry_id.meaning: the earlier work order entry this entry credits, corrects or answers; empty on entries that stand on their own

declared_value.meaning: the value the piece was taken in at for the chain's care, custody and control cover

appraisal_entry_id.meaning: primary id of the appraisal ledger entry

appraisal_order_id.meaning: the engagement this entry was booked to (foreign key -> appraisal_orders)

customer_id.meaning: the customer the engagement belongs to (foreign key -> customers)

event_type.meaning: which declared ledger family this entry belongs to, written verbatim as the event type

posted_date.meaning: the date the entry was booked to the engagement

amount.meaning: the signed size of the movement: fees the customer owes are positive, payments and credits are negative; on a valuation entry, the value stated

fee_code.meaning: which priced line this entry is; not_applicable on entries that price nothing

item_sku.format: four letters, a hyphen and five digits, e.g. RING-40218
item_sku.meaning: the piece this entry concerns; empty on entries that concern the engagement as a whole

valuation_approach.meaning: how the value on this entry was arrived at; not_applicable on entries that value nothing

credit_reason_code.meaning: why a fee was taken off; not_applicable on entries that take nothing off

payment_channel.meaning: the channel a payment arrived on; not_applicable on entries that are not payments

laboratory_code.meaning: the outside laboratory this entry concerns; none where no laboratory bears on it

billing_period.format: YYYY-MM, the year and month the entry is accounted to
billing_period.meaning: the accounting period this entry belongs to; the basis for every per-period count

source_entry_id.meaning: the earlier appraisal entry this entry credits or corrects; empty on entries that stand on their own

circle_membership_id.meaning: primary id of the loyalty membership record

customer_id.meaning: the customer who holds this membership (foreign key -> customers)

variant_name.meaning: the membership tier held, written as the official full tier name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the membership, on the basis defined by the category's lifecycle states

membership_number.format: BC- followed by eight digits, e.g. BC-40118263
membership_number.meaning: the membership number the customer quotes at the till

enrolled_date.meaning: the date the customer joined the programme

activated_date.meaning: the date the membership began earning; empty until it does

tier_effective_date.meaning: the date the current tier took effect; the anchor for every tier maintenance period

next_review_date.meaning: the date the tier is next reviewed against the qualifying spend

lapsed_date.meaning: the date the membership lapsed for inactivity; empty unless it has lapsed

closed_date.meaning: the date the membership closed; empty while it is still open

points_balance.meaning: how many points the member holds; identically the running sum of every points movement

qualifying_spend_ytd.meaning: qualifying spend recorded since the current tier took effect; the figure the tier review is decided on

lifetime_qualifying_spend.meaning: qualifying spend recorded over the whole life of the membership

referral_code.format: six upper-case letters and digits, e.g. K7R2QM
referral_code.meaning: the code this member gives to people they refer

preferred_store_code.format: two letters, a hyphen and three digits, e.g. BR-118
preferred_store_code.meaning: the store the member's benefits default to

concierge_assigned.meaning: whether a named concierge looks after this member

anniversary_month.meaning: the month the member's anniversary benefits fall in

circle_entry_id.meaning: primary id of the loyalty ledger entry

circle_membership_id.meaning: the membership this entry was booked to (foreign key -> circle_memberships)

customer_id.meaning: the customer the membership belongs to (foreign key -> customers)

event_type.meaning: which declared ledger family this entry belongs to, written verbatim as the event type

posted_date.meaning: the date the entry was booked to the membership

amount.meaning: the signed size of the points movement: points earned or granted are positive, points spent, taken back or expired are negative

qualifying_spend.meaning: the spend this entry rests on, positive on a purchase and negative on a return; zero where no spend bears on it

sales_receipt_number.format: BR- followed by a four-digit year, a hyphen and six digits, e.g. BR-2025-118406
sales_receipt_number.meaning: the till transaction this entry rests on; the narrowest key tying an accrual or a reversal to one sale

earn_category.meaning: what kind of spend the points were earned on; not_applicable on entries that earn nothing

multiplier.format: multiplier to one decimal place, e.g. 1.5
multiplier.meaning: the earning multiplier in force when the entry was booked; one where no multiplier applied

benefit_code.meaning: which member benefit this entry records the use of; not_applicable on entries that record no benefit

expiry_reason_code.meaning: why points fell away; not_applicable on entries where none did

billing_period.format: YYYY-MM, the year and month the entry is accounted to
billing_period.meaning: the accounting period this entry belongs to; the basis for every per-period count

source_entry_id.meaning: the earlier loyalty entry this entry reverses or answers; empty on entries that stand on their own

layaway_agreement_id.meaning: primary id of the layaway agreement record

customer_id.meaning: the customer who holds this agreement (foreign key -> customers)

variant_name.meaning: the layaway plan held, written as the official full plan name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the agreement, on the basis defined by the category's lifecycle states

agreement_reference.format: LA- followed by six digits, e.g. LA-330218
agreement_reference.meaning: the reference the customer is given for this agreement; the key every other desk cites it by

item_sku.format: four letters, a hyphen and five digits, e.g. RING-40218
item_sku.meaning: the piece being held on this agreement

item_description.meaning: the description of the held piece as it was written at the counter

sales_receipt_number.format: BR- followed by a four-digit year, a hyphen and six digits, e.g. BR-2025-118406
sales_receipt_number.meaning: the till transaction the agreement was opened on

store_code.format: two letters, a hyphen and three digits, e.g. BR-118

merchandise_total.meaning: the pre-tax price of the held merchandise; always positive

deposit_amount.meaning: what the customer put down when the agreement was opened

balance_due.meaning: what the customer still owes on this agreement; identically the running sum of every charge and payment booked to it

items_reserved.meaning: how many pieces are being held under this agreement; identically the running sum of every reserve movement

opened_date.meaning: the date the agreement was opened

first_payment_date.meaning: the date the first scheduled payment fell due

final_payment_due_date.meaning: the date the agreement must be paid up by; the boundary every term condition is measured against

completed_date.meaning: the date the agreement was paid up; empty until it is

closed_date.meaning: the date the agreement reached a terminal state; empty while it is still running

payment_frequency.meaning: how often a scheduled payment falls due on this agreement

scheduled_payment_amount.meaning: what the agreement asks for at each scheduled payment

days_past_due.meaning: how many calendar days the oldest unpaid scheduled payment is overdue; zero when the agreement is current

service_fee_amount.meaning: the service fee the plan charges for holding the merchandise

registry_reference.format: GR- followed by six digits, e.g. GR-118204
registry_reference.meaning: the gift registry this agreement belongs to; empty where it belongs to none

layaway_entry_id.meaning: primary id of the layaway ledger entry

layaway_agreement_id.meaning: the agreement this entry was booked to (foreign key -> layaway_agreements)

customer_id.meaning: the customer the agreement belongs to (foreign key -> customers)

event_type.meaning: which declared ledger family this entry belongs to, written verbatim as the event type

posted_date.meaning: the date the entry was booked to the agreement

amount.meaning: the signed size of the movement: charges the customer owes are positive, payments and credits negative; on a reserve entry, the count of pieces moved

fee_code.meaning: which priced charge this entry is; not_applicable on entries that charge nothing

item_sku.format: four letters, a hyphen and five digits, e.g. RING-40218
item_sku.meaning: the piece this entry concerns; empty on entries that concern the agreement as a whole

sales_receipt_number.format: BR- followed by a four-digit year, a hyphen and six digits, e.g. BR-2025-118406
sales_receipt_number.meaning: the till transaction this entry rests on

payment_channel.meaning: the channel a payment arrived on; not_applicable on entries that are not payments

payment_due_date.meaning: the scheduled payment date this entry answers; empty on entries no due date bears on

days_past_due.meaning: calendar days between the scheduled payment date and this entry's posting date; zero where nothing was overdue

statement_number.format: LS- followed by six digits, e.g. LS-441907
statement_number.meaning: the layaway statement this entry was presented on; empty on entries booked between statements

refund_reason_code.meaning: why money was returned; not_applicable on entries that return nothing

billing_period.format: YYYY-MM, the year and month the entry is accounted to
billing_period.meaning: the accounting period this entry belongs to; the basis for every per-period count

source_entry_id.meaning: the earlier layaway entry this entry refunds, credits or answers; empty on entries that stand on their own

layaway_request_id.meaning: primary id of the layaway service request record

customer_id.meaning: the customer who raised the request (foreign key -> customers)

layaway_agreement_id.meaning: the agreement the request concerns (foreign key -> layaway_agreements)

request_type.meaning: what the customer asked the layaway desk to arrange

request_status.meaning: where the request stands; recorded means taken but not yet confirmed by the customer

requested_amount.meaning: the amount the request carries, such as the revised scheduled payment; zero where it carries none

effective_date.meaning: the date the customer asked the arrangement to take effect from

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
created_at.meaning: the moment the request was taken

verification_id.meaning: primary id of the identity-verification record, keyed on the customer so the latest outcome replaces the earlier one

customer_id.meaning: the customer whose identity was checked (foreign key -> customers)

verified.meaning: whether the caller cleared identity verification; once true it never returns to false

verified_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
verified_at.meaning: the moment of the most recent verification attempt recorded against this customer

handoff_id.meaning: primary id of the human-handoff record

customer_id.meaning: the customer handed over to a human representative (foreign key -> customers)

reason.meaning: why the conversation was handed over; a closed set of exactly these two values

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
created_at.meaning: the moment the handover was recorded
